UI_setting_showClientAndServerReticleBet: Show both client and server reticle simultaneously
UI_setting_showServerSpgStrategicReticle: Enable server reticle for SPG strategic mode
UI_setting_gunMarkerMinimumSize_tooltip: Minimum size of the gun marker in pixels
UI_setting_percentCorrection_tooltip: Adjust the scale factor of the reticle
UI_setting_serverReticleAimingCircleShap: Select the shape of the server aiming circle
UI_setting_serverReticleAimingCircleOpac: Adjust the opacity of the server aiming circle
UI_setting_serverReticleGunMarkerShape_t: Select the shape of the server gun marker
UI_setting_serverReticleGunMarkerOpacity: Adjust the opacity of the server gun marker
